newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Prices quoted at steady levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Prices quoted at steady levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at steady levels on Thursday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. Four barges traded versus none on Wednesday.
- Four barges, Mid-Mississippi River, one each week of September, traded at 162-1/2 percent of tariff.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, bid 110 percent of tariff, unchanged from Wednesday, no offer.
- Ten barges, Mid-Mississippi River, two each week June, bid 110 percent, similar, unchanged from Wednesday, no offer.
- Four barges, Ohio River, one each week of September, bid 155 percent, no comparison, offer 162-1/2 percent.
- Four barges, Illinois River, one each week of September, bid 155 percent, no comparison, no offer.
